messages:
Maya: Heads up — eval CI failing on eval-runner after yesterday's kv-prefetch change in the q8 kernel path. exact_match_rate drops ~6% on our standard suite. Dashboard: https://redwood.internal/dashboards/eval/standard-suite :eyes:

Jonah: :eyes: which commit? PR #4321?

Maya: Yes, merged by @Arjun around 11:20pm UTC, commit abc1234. Reproducer locally: `pytest tests/eval_integration/test_suite.py::test_standard_suite -k quant` shows the failure.

Arjun: I saw a red canary earlier but assumed noise. I'll start a git bisect. Can someone add `--run-slow` flags to the job for better signal?

Sam: Pasting the failing assertion from the runner logs:
```
E AssertionError: metric 'exact_match_rate' decreased from 0.842 to 0.783 (delta -0.059)
  File "/workspace/runner/metrics.py", line 212, in compute_delta
```

Lia: Dashboard shows a spike in token-level perplexity for q8 kernels around step ~20. Looks correlated with the new prefetch branch. https://redwood.internal/dashboards/eval/perplexity-by-kernel

ci-bot: build 9342 failed on branch `main` — see tests: `eval-integration::standard-suite` (reruns disabled by policy).

Maya: Please don't rerun canaries yet. We need a clean bisect and a hold on the rollout. Mark release as blocked. :no_entry_sign:

Jonah: Running bisect between abc0000..abc1234 now. Quick local check: `python -m runner.main --config configs/standard.yml --quantize q8 --no-prefetch-kv` as control.

Arjun: Initial bisect points to commit abc10f7 — this introduced `kv_prefetch=True` on the quant path to optimize latency. Rolling that change back in staging yields EM back to baseline (~0.84).

Sam: Can we gate the feature with a runtime flag (feature/kv-prefetch) so we can toggle without kernel rollbacks? Seems like the fastest mitigation.

Lia: Also we should add a CI gating rule: block merges if exact_match_rate drops >2% for the baseline suite compared to canary baseline. That would have caught this.

Maya: Agreed. For now: rollback the kv-prefetch change in kernel packages on staging and pause the main rollout. @deploy-bot please schedule a rollback job.

deploy-bot: scheduled rollback job `rollback/177555-staging-01` for 2025-04-02T03:00:00Z — patch: revert commit abc10f7.

Jonah: Filing follow-ups: add unit tests to assert KV ordering invariance and add an integration test that runs the quant path with and without prefetch to compare outputs bitwise.

Arjun: Opened issue #587 and a draft PR to add the tests + a feature flag around `kv_prefetch`. Putting reviewer @Maya and @Lia.

ci-bot: note — observed flakey test `TestEvalRunner::test_streaming_consistency` in unrelated runs; excluding from the minimal bisect to reduce noise.

Maya: Good. Short-term action items: 1) hold release, 2) revert kv-prefetch on staging/prod kernels, 3) add CI gating for EM delta, 4) add unit+integration tests, 5) rollout new kernel only after tests pass and flag off by default.

Sam: Will draft the rollback PR and link it here when ready. :thumbsup:

Lia: I'll add the CI gating and dashboard alert thresholds (EM drop > 2% and token PPL spike). Ping me for alert tuning.

Maya: Thanks everyone. I'll update the release tracker and notify partners/ops. Postmortem scheduled next week.

Jonah: Quick note — logs we collected for the bisect are under `s3://redwood-eval-logs/bisect/1775554321/` in case anyone needs artifacts.

Arjun: Also, since this interacts with quant kernels, add kernel owners to the postmortem (cc @kernel-team).

Maya: Closing loop here for now. We'll re-open the thread if anything new pops up. :lock:
